description.value: Yuan's Garden is an award-winning sit-down restaurant in Richmond's Alexandra Road food corridor, serving authentic Jiangsu and Zhejiang cuisine rooted in a culinary tradition tracing back to 18th-century scholar Yuan Mei. Chef Ge Feng, a Nanjing native, has been recognized by the 2024 Chinese Restaurant Awards Critics' Choice for his Nanjing-Style Salted Duck and was nominated for Vancouver's Best Casual Chinese Restaurants the same year. The restaurant offers a full menu of dumplings, seafood, poultry, and vegetable dishes in a sit-down dining room that accepts table reservations.
